lessons.title: 第1课 · A puma at large

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Relative subject. Choose the correct form: Pumas are large, cat-like animals ___ are found in America.
questions.explanation: 关系词在定语从句中作主语；指物可用 which，不能用 what 或表示所属的 whose。
wrongReasons: “what”不符合这里的语法结构。关系词在定语从句中作主语；指物可用 which，不能用 what 或表示所属的 whose。
“whose”不符合这里的语法结构。关系词在定语从句中作主语；指物可用 which，不能用 what 或表示所属的 whose。

evidence.quote: Pumas are large, cat-like animals which are found in America.

questions.prompt: Change to the past perfect passive. Begin with "A wild puma" and omit the agent: People had spotted a wild puma.
answers: A wild puma had been spotted.
questions.explanation: 过去完成时被动结构为 had been + 过去分词，表示过去某时之前已发生的被动动作。

evidence.quote: a wild puma had been spotted

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Causative have. Choose the correct form: to have the church clock ___
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + 过去分词表示让人做某事；宾语与动词是被动关系。
wrongReasons: “repair”不符合这里的语法结构。have + 宾语 + 过去分词表示让人做某事；宾语与动词是被动关系。
“repairing”不符合这里的语法结构。have + 宾语 + 过去分词表示让人做某事；宾语与动词是被动关系。

evidence.quote: to have the church clock repaired

questions.prompt: Use the present perfect: The clock ___ silent ever since. (be) Write exactly 2 words.
answers: has been
questions.explanation: 现在完成时结构为 has/have + 过去分词；注意单复数和不规则动词。

evidence.quote: has been silent ever since

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Past deduction. Choose the correct form: The city at one time ___ prosperous
questions.explanation: 对过去情况的推测用情态动词 + have + 过去分词，不能误用现在时结构。
wrongReasons: “must be”不符合这里的语法结构。对过去情况的推测用情态动词 + have + 过去分词，不能误用现在时结构。
“must being”不符合这里的语法结构。对过去情况的推测用情态动词 + have + 过去分词，不能误用现在时结构。

evidence.quote: The city at one time must have been prosperous

questions.prompt: Change to the passive. Begin with "An interesting discovery" and keep the agent with "by": Archaeologists made an interesting discovery.
answers: An interesting discovery was made by archaeologists.
questions.explanation: 一般过去时被动结构为 was/were + 过去分词；注意不规则过去分词。

evidence.quote: an interesting discovery was made by archaeologists

lessons.title: 第4课 · The double life of Alfred Bloggs

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Gerund after a preposition. Choose the correct form: the privilege of ___ white-collar workers
questions.explanation: 介词后接名词或动名词；动词要改为 -ing 形式，不能直接接动词原形。
wrongReasons: “become”不符合这里的语法结构。介词后接名词或动名词；动词要改为 -ing 形式，不能直接接动词原形。
“to become”不符合这里的语法结构。介词后接名词或动名词；动词要改为 -ing 形式，不能直接接动词原形。

evidence.quote: the privilege of becoming white-collar workers

questions.prompt: Rewrite with inversion, beginning with "Such": Human nature is such.
answers: Such is human nature.
questions.explanation: 表语 such 置于句首时，系动词置于主语前：Such is human nature。

evidence.quote: Such is human nature

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Past perfect passive. Choose the correct form: a journalist ___ by a well-known magazine
questions.explanation: 过去完成时被动结构为 had been + 过去分词，表示过去某时之前已发生的被动动作。
wrongReasons: “had instructed”不符合这里的语法结构。过去完成时被动结构为 had been + 过去分词，表示过去某时之前已发生的被动动作。
“had been instructing”不符合这里的语法结构。过去完成时被动结构为 had been + 过去分词，表示过去某时之前已发生的被动动作。

evidence.quote: a journalist had been instructed by a well-known magazine

questions.prompt: Complete with the correct form of "publish": The editor refused ___ it. Write exactly 2 words.
answers: to publish
questions.explanation: 此处动词或形容词后接 to + 动词原形，不接动名词。

evidence.quote: refused to publish it

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Perfect continuous. Choose the correct form: Two of his assistants ___ busily since eight o’clock
questions.explanation: 完成进行时为 has/have/had been + doing，强调到参照时点持续进行的动作。
wrongReasons: “had working”不符合这里的语法结构。完成进行时为 has/have/had been + doing，强调到参照时点持续进行的动作。
“have been worked”不符合这里的语法结构。完成进行时为 has/have/had been + doing，强调到参照时点持续进行的动作。

evidence.quote: Two of his assistants had been working busily since eight o’clock

questions.prompt: Put these words in order, using every word or part once. Begin with "The shops" and put "just" after "were": just / the shops / opening / were
answers: The shops were just opening.
questions.explanation: 按英语句法排列主语、助动词、状语和主要动词；不要按中文顺序排列。

evidence.quote: The expensive shops in a famous arcade near Piccadilly were just opening.

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Modal bare infinitive. Choose the correct form: People who live in Britain ___ despair
questions.explanation: 情态动词后直接接动词原形，不加 to，也不加第三人称单数词尾。
wrongReasons: “needn’t to”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词后直接接动词原形，不加 to，也不加第三人称单数词尾。
“needn’t be”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词后直接接动词原形，不加 to，也不加第三人称单数词尾。

evidence.quote: People who live in Britain needn’t despair

questions.prompt: Expand the reduced clause with "which is". Write the whole noun phrase: a team called Mutilated Ladies.
answers: a team which is called Mutilated Ladies
questions.explanation: 名词与后置动词为被动关系时，可用过去分词作定语，相当于被动定语从句。

evidence.quote: a team called Mutilated Ladies

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Present participle modifier. Choose the correct form: travellers ___ the dangerous Pass
questions.explanation: 名词与后置动词为主动关系时，可用现在分词 -ing 作定语。
wrongReasons: “crossed”不符合这里的语法结构。名词与后置动词为主动关系时，可用现在分词 -ing 作定语。
“to crossing”不符合这里的语法结构。名词与后置动词为主动关系时，可用现在分词 -ing 作定语。

evidence.quote: travellers crossing the dangerous Pass

questions.prompt: Reduce the relative clause using a past participle: the monastery which was founded in the eleventh century.
answers: the monastery founded in the eleventh century
questions.explanation: 名词与后置动词为被动关系时，可用过去分词作定语，相当于被动定语从句。

evidence.quote: which was founded in the eleventh century

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Infinitive complement. Choose the correct form: Cats never fail ___ human beings.
questions.explanation: 此处动词或形容词后接 to + 动词原形，不接动名词。
wrongReasons: “fascinating”不符合这里的语法结构。此处动词或形容词后接 to + 动词原形，不接动名词。
“fascinate”不符合这里的语法结构。此处动词或形容词后接 to + 动词原形，不接动名词。

evidence.quote: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.

questions.prompt: Use the present perfect and the -ed form: Humans ___ to respect feline independence. (learn) Write exactly 2 words.
answers: have learned
questions.explanation: 现在完成时结构为 has/have + 过去分词；注意单复数和不规则动词。

evidence.quote: humans have learned to respect feline independence

lessons.title: 第10课 · The loss of the Titanic

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Past continuous. Choose the correct form: She ___ 1,316 passengers and a crew of 891.
questions.explanation: 过去进行时结构为 was/were + 动词 -ing；注意主语的单复数。
wrongReasons: “were carrying”不符合这里的语法结构。过去进行时结构为 was/were + 动词 -ing；注意主语的单复数。
“was carry”不符合这里的语法结构。过去进行时结构为 was/were + 动词 -ing；注意主语的单复数。

evidence.quote: She was carrying 1,316 passengers and a crew of 891.

questions.prompt: Use the past perfect passive and include "ever": the largest ship that ___ . (build) Write exactly 4 words.
answers: had ever been built
questions.explanation: 过去完成时被动结构为 had been + 过去分词，表示过去某时之前已发生的被动动作。

evidence.quote: the largest ship that had ever been built

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Passive causative make. Choose the correct form: honest people are often made ___ guilty
questions.explanation: 主动 make somebody do 变被动后，须补回 to，成为 be made to do。
wrongReasons: “feel”不符合这里的语法结构。主动 make somebody do 变被动后，须补回 to，成为 be made to do。
“feeling”不符合这里的语法结构。主动 make somebody do 变被动后，须补回 to，成为 be made to do。

evidence.quote: honest people are often made to feel guilty

questions.prompt: Make a yes/no question: You are going through the Green Channel.
answers: Are you going through the Green Channel?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句将已有的助动词或 be 提到主语前；没有助动词的实义动词句需用 do/does/did。

evidence.quote: when you are going through the Green Channel

lessons.title: 第12课 · Life on a desert island

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Relative place. Choose the correct form: a sort of paradise ___ the sun always shines
questions.explanation: 先行词在从句中作地点状语，用 where；从句的主语和谓语已经完整。
wrongReasons: “which”不符合这里的语法结构。先行词在从句中作地点状语，用 where；从句的主语和谓语已经完整。
“what”不符合这里的语法结构。先行词在从句中作地点状语，用 where；从句的主语和谓语已经完整。

evidence.quote: a sort of paradise where the sun always shines

questions.prompt: Make this statement negative, using "not": Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
answers: Most of us have not formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
Most of us haven't formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
questions.explanation: 否定结构在助动词后加 not；用 do/does/did 时，实义动词还原。

evidence.quote: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Too ... to. Choose the correct form: She was ___ excited to do any housework that morning
questions.explanation: too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度太高以致不能做；enough 与 very 不能直接替换该结构。
wrongReasons: “enough”不符合这里的语法结构。too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度太高以致不能做；enough 与 very 不能直接替换该结构。
“very”不符合这里的语法结构。too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度太高以致不能做；enough 与 very 不能直接替换该结构。

evidence.quote: She was too excited to do any housework that morning

questions.prompt: Make a yes/no question in the past perfect: Her husband had gone to work.
answers: Had her husband gone to work?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句将已有的助动词或 be 提到主语前；没有助动词的实义动词句需用 do/does/did。

evidence.quote: her husband had gone to work

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Gerund subject. Choose the correct form: ___ ‘protection money’ is not a modern crime.
questions.explanation: 动名词短语可作主语；在此处不能直接用动词原形作主语。
wrongReasons: “Obtain”不符合这里的语法结构。动名词短语可作主语；在此处不能直接用动词原形作主语。
“Obtained”不符合这里的语法结构。动名词短语可作主语；在此处不能直接用动词原形作主语。

evidence.quote: Obtaining ‘protection money’ is not a modern crime.

questions.prompt: Change to active. Begin with "If people": If the money was not paid promptly.
answers: If people did not pay the money promptly.
If people didn't pay the money promptly.
questions.explanation: 主动和被动转换须保留时态；被动主语是原主动宾语，使用 be + 过去分词。

evidence.quote: If the money was not paid promptly

lessons.title: 第15课 · Fifty pence worth of trouble

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Present simple passive. Choose the correct form: If fifty pence pieces ___ for sweets
questions.explanation: 一般现在时被动结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词；主语是动作的承受者。
wrongReasons: “do not exchange”不符合这里的语法结构。一般现在时被动结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词；主语是动作的承受者。
“are not exchanging”不符合这里的语法结构。一般现在时被动结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词；主语是动作的承受者。

evidence.quote: If fifty pence pieces are not exchanged for sweets

questions.prompt: Make a yes/no question using "do": Children always appreciate small gifts of money.
answers: Do children always appreciate small gifts of money?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句将已有的助动词或 be 提到主语前；没有助动词的实义动词句需用 do/does/did。

evidence.quote: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.

lessons.title: 第16课 · Mary had a little lamb

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Past perfect. Choose the correct form: a little white lamb which her husband ___ her
questions.explanation: 过去完成时为 had + 过去分词，不能在 had 后接一般过去式或 -ing。
wrongReasons: “had gave”不符合这里的语法结构。过去完成时为 had + 过去分词，不能在 had 后接一般过去式或 -ing。
“had giving”不符合这里的语法结构。过去完成时为 had + 过去分词，不能在 had 后接一般过去式或 -ing。

evidence.quote: a little white lamb which her husband had given her

questions.prompt: Complete using a past participle: She kept it ___ to a tree. (tie) Write exactly 1 word.
answers: tied
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 过去分词表示使宾语保持某种被动状态；it 指羊，是被拴住的，因此用 tied。这是宾语补足语，不是后置定语。

evidence.quote: She kept it tied to a tree

lessons.title: 第17课 · The longest suspension bridge in the world

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Relative person after a preposition. Choose the correct form: an Italian about ___ little is known
questions.explanation: 介词提前时，指人的关系代词作宾语用 whom。
wrongReasons: “who”不符合这里的语法结构。介词提前时，指人的关系代词作宾语用 whom。
“which”不符合这里的语法结构。介词提前时，指人的关系代词作宾语用 whom。

evidence.quote: an Italian about whom little is known

questions.prompt: Change to the passive. Begin with "Four huge cables" and keep the agent with "by": Two great towers support four huge cables.
answers: Four huge cables are supported by two great towers.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时被动结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词；主语是动作的承受者。

evidence.quote: Two great towers support four huge cables.

lessons.title: 第18课 · Electric currents in modern art

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Modal perfect. Choose the correct form: people who take no interest in art ___ to notice
questions.explanation: 情态动词完成结构为情态动词 + have + 过去分词；have 不随主语变化。
wrongReasons: “cannot has failed”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词完成结构为情态动词 + have + 过去分词；have 不随主语变化。
“cannot have fail”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词完成结构为情态动词 + have + 过去分词；have 不随主语变化。

evidence.quote: people who take no interest in art cannot have failed to notice

questions.prompt: Make this statement negative with "does not": Modern sculpture surprises us.
answers: Modern sculpture does not surprise us.
Modern sculpture doesn't surprise us.
questions.explanation: 否定结构在助动词后加 not；用 do/does/did 时，实义动词还原。

evidence.quote: Modern sculpture rarely surprises us any more.

lessons.title: 第19课 · A very dear cat

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Present simple agreement. Choose the correct form: He usually ___ a short walk in the evenings
questions.explanation: 一般现在时第三人称单数主语后，实义动词需用第三人称单数形式。
wrongReasons: “take”不符合这里的语法结构。一般现在时第三人称单数主语后，实义动词需用第三人称单数形式。
“taking”不符合这里的语法结构。一般现在时第三人称单数主语后，实义动词需用第三人称单数形式。

evidence.quote: He usually takes a short walk in the evenings

questions.prompt: Replace "failed to" with "did not manage to": He failed to arrive.
answers: He did not manage to arrive.
He didn't manage to arrive.
questions.explanation: 此处动词或形容词后接 to + 动词原形，不接动名词。

evidence.quote: he failed to arrive

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Past simple passive. Choose the correct form: before the first attempt ___
questions.explanation: 一般过去时被动结构为 was/were + 过去分词；注意不规则过去分词。
wrongReasons: “made”不符合这里的语法结构。一般过去时被动结构为 was/were + 过去分词；注意不规则过去分词。
“was making”不符合这里的语法结构。一般过去时被动结构为 was/were + 过去分词；注意不规则过去分词。

evidence.quote: before the first attempt was made

questions.prompt: Change to active. Begin with "Engine failure" and use "forced him": He was forced to land on the sea.
answers: Engine failure forced him to land on the sea.
questions.explanation: 主动和被动转换须保留时态；被动主语是原主动宾语，使用 be + 过去分词。

evidence.quote: he was forced to land on the sea

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Modal passive. Choose the correct form: a prizefighter could ___ seriously injured or even killed
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。
wrongReasons: “been”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。
“being”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。

evidence.quote: a prizefighter could be seriously injured or even killed

questions.prompt: Make a yes/no question: They were known as prizefighters.
answers: Were they known as prizefighters?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句将已有的助动词或 be 提到主语前；没有助动词的实义动词句需用 do/does/did。

evidence.quote: they were known as ‘prizefighters’

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Go on doing. Choose the correct form: actors who are required to go on ___ the same lines
questions.explanation: go on doing 表示继续做同一件事；后接动名词，不是动词原形。
wrongReasons: “repeat”不符合这里的语法结构。go on doing 表示继续做同一件事；后接动名词，不是动词原形。
“to repeating”不符合这里的语法结构。go on doing 表示继续做同一件事；后接动名词，不是动词原形。

evidence.quote: actors who are required to go on repeating the same lines

questions.prompt: Rewrite with "such ... that". Begin with "They are such": Some plays are so successful that they run for years on end.
answers: They are such successful plays that they run for years on end.
questions.explanation: so 后接形容词；such 后接名词短语，注意单复数和冠词。

evidence.quote: Some plays are so successful that they run for years on end.

lessons.title: 第23课 · One man’s meat is another man’s poison

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Second conditional. Choose the correct form: If you lived in the Mediterranean, for instance, you ___ octopus a great delicacy.
questions.explanation: 假设现在的非真实情形，if 从句用过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形。
wrongReasons: “will consider”不符合这里的语法结构。假设现在的非真实情形，if 从句用过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形。
“would considered”不符合这里的语法结构。假设现在的非真实情形，if 从句用过去式，主句用 would + 动词原形。

evidence.quote: If you lived in the Mediterranean, for instance, you would consider octopus a great delicacy.

questions.prompt: Change to the passive, beginning with "What": What can people eat?
answers: What can be eaten?
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。

evidence.quote: what can be eaten and what cannot be eaten

lessons.title: 第24课 · A skeleton in the cupboard

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Present perfect passive. Choose the correct form: secret which ___ from strangers for years
questions.explanation: 现在完成时被动结构为 has/have been + 过去分词；注意主语的单复数。
wrongReasons: “has concealed”不符合这里的语法结构。现在完成时被动结构为 has/have been + 过去分词；注意主语的单复数。
“has been concealing”不符合这里的语法结构。现在完成时被动结构为 has/have been + 过去分词；注意主语的单复数。

evidence.quote: secret which has been concealed from strangers for years

questions.prompt: Change to active. Begin with "People": The terrible secret is called a skeleton in the cupboard.
answers: People call the terrible secret a skeleton in the cupboard.
questions.explanation: 主动和被动转换须保留时态；被动主语是原主动宾语，使用 be + 过去分词。

evidence.quote: The terrible secret is called ‘a skeleton in the cupboard’.

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Modal passive. Choose the correct form: can still ___ at Greenwich
questions.explanation: 情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。
wrongReasons: “be saw”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。
“see”不符合这里的语法结构。情态动词被动结构为情态动词 + be + 过去分词，不是 been 或 being。

evidence.quote: can still be seen at Greenwich

questions.prompt: Change to active. Begin with "Thousands of people": She is visited by thousands of people each year.
answers: Thousands of people visit her each year.
questions.explanation: 主动和被动转换须保留时态；被动主语是原主动宾语，使用 be + 过去分词。

evidence.quote: is visited by thousands of people each year

lessons.title: 第26课 · Wanted: a large biscuit tin

questions.prompt: Grammar focus: Passive gerund. Choose the correct form: No one can avoid ___ by advertisements.
questions.explanation: 此处既需要动名词又需要被动含义，所以用 being + 过去分词。
wrongReasons: “be influenced”不符合这里的语法结构。此处既需要动名词又需要被动含义，所以用 being + 过去分词。
